title: Normalized finite restriction squares for the fixed integral comparison
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, and a scheme X. Use the continuous integral and positive finite quotient rings of [sk-def-pe-derived-completion], the concrete integral section-action encoding A of [def-pe-integral-presentation-encoding], and the finite encodings of [def-pe-finite-discrete-presentation-encoding]. Suppose the underlying abelian map of A.ringIso is a specified integral comparison e satisfying [def-sfb-integral-comparison-normalization], with the endpoint identifications of [def-sfb-integral-comparison-coefficients]. Then there are normalized finite encodings f_n and restriction squares Mod.comap(quotient_n) followed by A.modules.functor isomorphic to f_n.ordinary.functor followed by scalarReductionRestriction_n. The square is the identity on underlying abelian sections, expressed by SquareNormalized of [lem-pe-integral-completion-presentation]. The originally specified A is retained; there is no completeness, constructibility, or Noetherian hypothesis.

proof.text: Choose the finite normalized encodings from the existing normalized-square existence theorem. The new projection normalization fixes the coefficient ring equation for the specified A. Reconstruct the scalar restriction square, associate consecutive restrictions, use that ring equation, and unassociate. Transport the ends along A.functor_eq and f.ordinary_functor. Each component is identity on abelian sections, giving SquareNormalized with exactly those two transports.

lean.statement:
theorem fixed_integral_section_squares
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (X : Scheme.{u})
    (A : Encoding l E X)
    (e : (coefficientRing X (sfbCondensedIntegers l E)).X ≅ sfbCompletedIntegersAb l E X)
    (he : SfbIntegralComparison l E X e)
    (hsrc : (sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1} ⋙
        forget₂ RingCat.{u + 1} Ab.{u + 1})).obj
          (InternalAbelianSheafModule.sectionRingSheaf.{u + 1, u + 1, u}
            (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (AdicCompletion.ring l E X)) =
        (coefficientRing X (sfbCondensedIntegers l E)).X)
    (htgt : (sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1} ⋙
        forget₂ RingCat.{u + 1} Ab.{u + 1})).obj
          (WeilConjectures.completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) =
        sfbCompletedIntegersAb l E X)
    (hc : (sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1} ⋙
        forget₂ RingCat.{u + 1} Ab.{u + 1})).map A.ringIso.hom =
          eqToHom hsrc ≫ e.hom ≫ eqToHom htgt.symm) :
    ∃ (f : ∀ n : ℕ, FiniteEncoding l E X n)
      (a : ∀ n : ℕ, RestrictionSquare l E X A n (f n)),
      ∀ n : ℕ, SquareNormalized l E X A n (f n) (a n)
